_readme: Read by the Dependency Vulnerability Audit (scripts/ci/npm-audit-gate.mjs) and security-sla-enforcement.yml. One entry per advisory and package; high runs at most 30 days, critical never. Process: docs/security/SECURITY.md#exception-process. Owner review required (CODEOWNERS).

exceptions.reason: ReDoS in picomatch <= 4.0.7 (CVE-2026-112366), published 2026-11-17 with no patched release (4.0.7 is the latest; fix pending upstream in micromatch/picomatch#194). Reached only through dev tooling: vite, vitest, tinyglobby, fdir, jscodeshift, lint-staged. `npm audit --omit=dev` reports 0 at the root and in workers/oursharedevents, so it is not in the deployed Worker.
exceptions.mitigation: Dev and CI only: the globs picomatch compiles come from this repo's own config and test files, never from a request or a user. Remove this entry and bump picomatch as soon as a patched release is published.
